name: 오봉수

appearance_en.face_shape: broad heavy face, wide strong cheekbones, deep-set jaw held in chronic tension — the face of a man who has been in argument with the world for 30 years and has no intention of stopping
appearance_en.skin: medium-dark Korean skin, sun-weathered from decades of outdoor neighbourhood life, deep nasolabial folds, rough horizontal forehead lines, coarse uneven texture from decades of unmanaged outdoor exposure
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown faded eyes, heavy-lidded, gaze direct and combative — perpetually on the verge of confrontation, rarely blinks during an argument. The eyes of a man who mistakes loudness for strength
appearance_en.nose: broad flat nose, wide rounded tip, prominent and solid — adds to the physical combativeness of the face
appearance_en.mouth: medium lips pressed tight, jaw muscles visibly working — the mouth that delivers '나는 죽어도 안 나가' with absolute conviction even when the hand is already packing boxes
appearance_en.eyebrows: thick salt-and-pepper brows, nearly permanently furrowed, rise dramatically when indignant — the most expressive feature on a face otherwise set in defiance
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: deep nasolabial folds, forehead creases carved by decades of scowling, age spots at temples, neck tension visible when voice rises
appearance_en.hair: short coarse salt-and-pepper hair, thinning slightly at crown, combed simply — presentation is not a priority

body.proportions: compact solid frame, broad shoulders set forward, slight barrel chest, midsection thickened by age, sturdy legs planted wide
body.posture: wide-based and forward-leaning — the posture of a man always ready to make his case. Leans in when arguing, never steps back
body.body_prompt: 165cm compact solid Korean man, broad forward-set shoulders, barrel chest, wide-base planted combative posture

default.description: plain work shirt or padded vest over worn shirt, practical dark trousers — the clothes of a man who has never once considered appearance and never will
default.wardrobe_prompt: plain dark work shirt or padded vest over worn shirt, practical dark trousers, no accessories

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: defiant authority at rest — the face of a man who has chosen anger over grief, and is only now beginning to understand the difference
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 68-year-old Korean man, broad heavy face with wide cheekbones and tight jaw, thick salt-and-pepper furrowed brows, heavy-lidded faded combative eyes, broad flat nose, tight pressed lips with jaw muscles visible, short coarse salt-and-pepper hair, 165cm compact solid forward-set posture, medium-dark weathered Korean skin with deep forehead and nasolabial lines

style_prompt: masako style illustration, bold manga ink lines, strong grey-brown screen tone, earthy muted palette, cinematic Korean drama composition, defiance masking fear, physical stubbornness in every line
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, western comic, gentle, soft, smiling, young, slim
